title: Stop mise's activation banner from poisoning stdout captures in the release and install scripts
action: mise prints an activation line naming its config file and the tool version to STDOUT on every shimmed invocation, e.g. running gh --version emits that line before the version. bee captures tool stdout in four places and two of them break on it. release.sh:284 does RUN_ID=$(gh run list ... --jq .[0].databaseId) and gets the banner as the run id, so the follow-up lookup 404s and the release never reaches its final OK line - this happened live on 2026-08-30 during the 2.25.1 release. release.sh:295 does ASSETS=$(gh release view ... --jq .assets[].name) and gets a bogus first asset name. install.sh:420 and :425 redirect codex/claude plugin list --json into files, and the banner makes the JSON unparseable; the installer then reports package-list shape drift, which is the wrong cause - verified by test that merge-plugin-state accepts the codex object shape once the banner is gone. FIX: export MISE_QUIET=1 once near the top of BOTH scripts, beside the other environment setup, each with a one-line comment naming why (a mise shim writes its activation banner to stdout and would land inside these captures). Do not wrap individual call sites - one export per script is the whole change. Additionally, in install.sh, widen the merge-plugin-state failure message so it no longer asserts shape drift as the only cause: it must also name an unparseable probe file and point at the tool wrapper writing to stdout. Keep both scripts passing bash -n. Then run the regen chain in THIS cell: bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order), because both scripts are hashed roots of the release manifest.
verify: bash -n scripts/release.sh && bash -n scripts/install.sh && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: MISE_QUIET=1 is exported once near the top of scripts/release.sh
MISE_QUIET=1 is exported once near the top of scripts/install.sh
Each export carries a one-line comment naming the stdout-banner reason
No individual gh/codex/claude call site is wrapped or changed
The install.sh merge failure message names an unparseable probe file, not shape drift alone
bash -n is clean on both scripts and the release manifest check is clean

trace.outcome: MISE_QUIET=1 exported once in each script; the install failure message now names an unparseable probe file too
deviations: Ran the tiny cell inline in the MAIN checkout instead of a feature worktree — AGENTS.md exempts a solo tiny fix when no other session is live, and bee state session list showed only this session live — found a better route

report.outcome: MISE_QUIET=1 exported once per script so the mise banner cannot enter a stdout capture
report.tests: bash -n both scripts && bee dev release-manifest --check — green — shell-only change plus the regen the manifest obligation requires; a live before/after capture of the exact gh run-id read proved the bug and the fix
